Ahhh. 
Places like this make even the days a little more doable. Wouldn't you say?

3.interaction_text:
This is the cultivation section. We raise orchids here before they join the garden displays.
I'm checking this batch today. There's always another pot to tend!

4.interaction_text:
I'm helping with the potting today.
Keeping track of all these plants is quite a job. I hope I haven't mixed up any labels!

5.interaction_text:
I came for the flowers, but watching the gardeners work is interesting too.
I'd like to try growing an orchid at home someday.
